title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 39
paragraphs: These two, the Delphians say, were the local heroes Phylacos and Autonoös, whose sacred precincts stand around the temple — Phylacos's just beside the road above the temple of Pronaia, Autonoös's near Castalia under the peak called Hyampeia. Moreover, the rocks that had fallen from Parnassos were still preserved even in my time, lying in the sacred precinct of Athena Pronaia, into which they fell when they hurtled through the ranks of the barbarians. Such, then, was the departure of these men from the temple.
